description: Validate retention_sweeper.py (exists on disk per gaps map but was quarantined 2026-04-19). The quarantined version failed cohort_1_n1 three times. Create a fresh validation harness that tests evidence_blob expiry logic: verify rows older than 30 days in mcp_signal_scores and mcp_signal_enrichments would be flagged for cleanup.
